description: Fetch structure metadata (title, method, resolution) from RCSB PDB

input_schema.description:
Input for PDB entry metadata fetch.

Attributes:
    pdb_id (str): PDB accession (e.g. '1LBG').
input_schema.title: PdbFetchEntryInput

config_schema.description: Configuration for PDB entry metadata fetches (no user-facing settings).

verbose.description: Verbosity level (0=quiet, 1=info, 2=debug, 3=raw subprocess stderr). True→1, False→0.
verbose.title: Verbose

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. None waits indefinitely.
timeout.title: Timeout

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Some cacheable tools gate cache on this field.
seed.title: Random Seed

config_schema.title: PdbFetchEntryConfig

output_schema.description:
Output from PDB entry metadata fetch.

Attributes:
    title (str | None): Structure title.
    method (str | None): Experimental method.
    resolution (float | None): Resolution in angstroms.
    source_url (str | None): URL used for the request.

method.description: PDB experimental method (e.g. X-RAY DIFFRACTION, SOLUTION NMR, ELECTRON MICROSCOPY)
method.title: Experimental Method

resolution.description: Resolution in Å (None for NMR or fiber diffraction)
resolution.title: Resolution

output_schema.title: PdbFetchEntryOutput
